v01_petpooja_pos.webhook: POST /api/v1/webhooks/pos/petpooja - HMAC-SHA256 signature via x-petpooja-signature; mock accepts valid_sig_ prefix (mirrors Razorpay seam)
v01_petpooja_pos.idempotency: pos_order_id keyed; PosOrderRepository mapping; retried delivery returns {processed:false, idempotent:true} with no duplicate order (verified live + test)
v01_petpooja_pos.order_import: pre-paid POS orders created directly at CONFIRMED, skipping DRAFT/PAYMENT_PENDING
v01_petpooja_pos.item_pricing: pricing authoritative from synced catalog; unsynced pos_item_id rejected 400 POS_ITEM_NOT_SYNCED
v01_petpooja_pos.menu_sync: POST /api/vendor/pos/sync-menu upserts keyed on (restaurant_id, pos_item_id); running twice converges (verified: 4 -> 4, no duplicates)
v01_petpooja_pos.simulate: POST /api/vendor/pos/simulate-order syncs then imports a sample order end to end
v01_petpooja_pos.events: PosOrderImported + PosMenuSynced added to EOS Layer 1.2 Event Catalog (10 events total)

v08_insights.peak_hours: 24 fixed buckets in IST via explicit +5:30 offset (deterministic, not locale formatter)
v08_insights.ui: apps/vendor/app/insights/page.tsx - AOV + Repeat Rate cards, pure-div teal bar chart, teal shimmer skeletons, 7/30/90-day selector

stable_identity.evidence: phone-keyed MemoryIdentityRepository; auth resolveUser now reuses the shared repo (was random UUID per login); verified live: two OTP logins same phone -> same user_id

pos_ui.evidence: apps/vendor/app/pos/page.tsx - mock Petpooja connect via localStorage, Sync Menu Now + Send Test Order with teal shimmer; VendorNav extended with Insights + POS links

verifications: POST same pos_order_id retry -> processed:false, idempotent:true, same order_id
